form_inputs.do_not_regress_rules:
ai_briefing.evidence_files.ai_briefing_json must use hash_status self_hash_not_embedded.
ai_briefing.evidence_files.ai_briefing_json.sha256 must be an empty string because the briefing cannot embed its own final sha256 without changing itself.
ai_briefing.evidence_files.ai_briefing_json.size_status must be self_size_not_embedded and size_bytes must be 0.
The bundle manifest remains the hash authority for the final ai_briefing_json artifact.
bundle_manifest.artifacts.ai_briefing_json.sha256 must match the actual final ai_briefing JSON bytes.
AI handoff upload ZIPs must contain the self-reference briefing metadata, not a stale embedded self-hash.
AI briefing dynamic path policy must use <project_drive>:\<project_slug>_show_project_to_AI\second_prompt_files and must not mention _architecture_audit as the real current output folder.
Handoff ZIP members and JSON/TXT/MD contents must not expose second_prompt_files_building or .json_handoff_zip_stage staging paths.
Project-specific frozen memory must remain under project_freeze_after_update/frozen_features_memory and not under project_freeze_ledger.

Do not store project-specific frozen memory inside project_freeze_ledger.

After a local freeze write, the AI startup freeze context must be refreshed.
External AI review remains advanced/fallback, not the normal local freeze path.
